ctx.x: You tell me about the -- I think I have -- the other part of this history in my life, fortunately, Mr. Tiger Flowers, he taught me all these -- important people's names in the fight -- in the prize fighting business at the time, and there was one gentleman named George Roby, which was Miss Lucille Achet's father-in-law. Now, Miss Lucille Achet, she used to have a record shop next door to the 81 Theater.
